name: Tomiya (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Tomiya city emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised bird-like character.
history: Municipal flag of Tomiya, a city in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 August 1966.

features.role: Tomiya city emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised bird-like character
